name: Light → Dim Relative
description: This [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) allows you to dim a light that supports brightness by a relative amount.

config_entries.label: Relative Brightness
config_entries.description: The relative brightness to dim the light by.

config_entries.label: Limit Mode
config_entries.description: What to do when the current brightness is outside of the limit range. Defaults to `CLAMP`. Valid limit modes are:

options.label: CLAMP
options.description: Clamp the brightness to the limit range.

options.label: DO_NOTHING
options.description: No dimming if the brightness is outside the limit range.

config_entries.label: Max Brightness
config_entries.description: The maximum brightness to dim the light to. Defaults to `100%`.

config_entries.label: Min Brightness
config_entries.description: The minimum brightness to dim the light to. Defaults to `0%`.
